concept: Now Playing: Cafe Mondegar, Colaba as a jukebox playlist. Every scene is a record the jukebox picks: a coin drops, the needle lands on the cafe name, a 3D map dive follows a neon route to Colaba Causeway, a record flip carries us into the mural wall, the jukebox selector is pressed on camera, and the end card is the last record spinning to a stop. Equalizer bars driven by the voice and music tie sound to picture.
status: v2 after "make it pop" feedback (L054): bolder hook, 14 animations, raea render; user did not object to cafe or concept
